pack: Consolidated Postfiatd Post-Quantum Security Evaluation Pack

stages.title: Stop the bleeding: no protocol change, no new cryptography

items.action: Publish an Ed25519 signature and a SHA-256 checksum file with every GitHub release, plus a verifier script in the repo.
items.exit: A release exists whose signature verifies with the published key; the upgrade docs point at the verifier.

items.action: Pin Docker images by digest (image@sha256:...) in deployment docs; stop directing operators to -latest tags.
items.exit: No deployment doc references a mutable -latest tag.

items.action: Require authentication on /api/tasks (or strip the endpoint for anonymous callers); return 401/403, not 200, for anonymous reads.
items.exit: Anonymous GET /api/tasks returns 401/403; authenticated reads unchanged.

items.action: Set an explicit TLS version floor (TLS 1.2 minimum) and an explicit TLS 1.3 ciphersuite list for the peer port; pass the operator ssl_ciphers list to the peer listener.
items.exit: Peer TLS policy is written down and enforced by the context, not by OpenSSL defaults.

items.action: Correct the quorum comment in ValidatorList.cpp: state that the pi+pj < .33*ni bound holds only at zero Byzantine faults.
items.exit: Comment text matches Theorem 8; the correction is reviewed.

items.action: Publish /robots.txt; return a real 404 for unknown /api/* paths; document API rate limits.
items.exit: Probes P-01..P-06 re-run: shell/robots/404 behavior as documented.

stages.note: S0 closes the highest-exploitability findings first. Nothing in S0 needs a new algorithm, a fork, or an amendment.

stages.title: Hybrid protection on the two exposed paths: releases and peer transport

items.action: Ship the PFQS v1 hybrid release envelope (8-byte header + 64 B Ed25519 + 2,420 B ML-DSA-44 = 2,492 B, AND-verification, exact-length check) alongside the S0 Ed25519 signature.
items.exit: A release carries a PFQS v1 envelope that verifies at 5,051.9/s and rejects stripped halves (controls C-4/C-5).

items.action: Publish the release-key rotation procedure (key generation, publication, revocation, rotation cadence) and name the key custodian role.
items.exit: Rotation procedure exists in the repo and has been exercised once on a test release.

items.action: Add a signed manifest sequence number to releases (rollback protection) and enforce monotonic sequence on upgrade.
items.exit: An operator cannot be rolled back to an older signed release without an explicit override.

items.action: Implement the hybrid KEM peer handshake (H-1 wire: 3-byte header + 32 B X25519 pubkey + ML-KEM ciphertext; 803/1,123/1,603 B) behind a testnet flag.
items.exit: Two testnet peers complete a hybrid handshake; measured totals match this pack (170.17/183.13/206.37 us).

stages.note: S1 is the first stage that ships post-quantum cryptography. The hybrid (classical + PQ, AND-verification) shape means a break in either half alone does not break the system.

stages.title: Governance observability and PQ validation signatures

items.action: Make per-amendment vote counts publicly readable (or enable PF_ValidatorVoteTracking and publish its output); a vote must be observable to be auditable.
items.exit: The public feature RPC (or a published tracker) shows count/validations/threshold per amendment.

items.action: Design and testnet-gate ML-DSA validation signatures for validator manifests (dual-signed validations during transition; secp256k1 retained until the network migrates).
items.exit: A testnet validator publishes a dual-signed validation that verifies under both schemes.

items.action: Allow TLS 1.3 in the outbound HTTPS client (validator-site and exclusion-list fetches).
items.exit: Outbound fetches negotiate TLS 1.3 where the server offers it.

stages.note: S2 turns the two observability gaps (votes, validations) from findings into operated features.

stages.title: PQ in the TLS stack and long-lived signatures

items.action: Add ML-KEM to the TLS stack via an OpenSSL provider (open decision D-02: provider choice) and negotiate hybrid ciphersuites on the peer port.
items.exit: Peer TLS negotiates a hybrid key exchange on testnet; the X-Wing all-zero check is enforced in the combiner.

items.action: Evaluate SLH-DSA-128f for long-lived release signatures (stateless, hash-based; 17,088 B, verify 897.5/s) as a second PQ half for archival releases.
items.exit: A dated decision record: SLH-DSA adopted or rejected for archival releases, with the measured costs attached.

items.action: Apply the FIPS 203 section 7.3 length check in the application layer wherever ML-KEM ciphertexts are accepted.
items.exit: Invalid-length ciphertexts are rejected with an explicit error before decapsulation.

stages.note: S3 depends on an upstream OpenSSL provider with ML-KEM support; if none is available, the S1 hybrid handshake stays the transport protection and S3 is re-planned.

stages.title: Mainnet readiness: close the governance and quorum gates

items.action: Decide the 67% -> 80% quorum revert explicitly and record the decision; do not go to mainnet on an undecided quorum.
items.exit: A dated decision record names the mainnet quorum and the evidence for it.

items.action: Complete the PQ migration on all five surfaces (scorecard >= 4 on every surface) before mainnet; re-run this pack's benchmarks on the migration build.
items.exit: Scorecard re-issued with every surface >= 4 and fresh measurements attached.

stages.note: S4 is a gate, not a workstream: mainnet does not proceed while any surface scores below 4.

open_decisions.text: Release-key distribution and rotation procedure: not specified in this pack; S1-2 must define it. Until then, PFQS v1 envelopes are verifiable but their keys have no published lifecycle.
ML-KEM TLS provider choice (which OpenSSL provider supplies ML-KEM, and which hybrid ciphersuites are negotiated): not specified; S3-1 must choose. The S1 hybrid handshake does not depend on it.
Signed manifest sequence / rollback field: PFQS v1 has no timestamp or sequence field by design; rollback protection is a separate S1-3 manifest field, not part of the envelope.
SLH-DSA adoption for archival releases: deferred to S3-2 with measured costs attached; ML-DSA-44 is the only PQ half in PFQS v1.
Mainnet quorum (67% vs 80%): undecided; S4-1 is the decision gate. The 67% comment bound (C-D01) is wrong regardless of which quorum is chosen.
